name: Goblet Squat
description: A squat holding one dumbbell upright against your chest, which helps keep your chest up and your balance forward.

source.title: Goblet Squat (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Hold one end of a dumbbell with both hands, upright against your chest.
Feet a little wider than hip-width.
cues: Sit your hips back and down between your heels.
Keep your chest up and the weight close.

prescription.note: Pick a weight you can lift for every rep with good form. Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Squat
keyframes.cue: Lower as far as is comfortable.
